system.description:
Range: Self

Area: 5-space-radius

You devour the pain and suffering of those around you, using it to replenish yourself.

As an Action, you can regain 1 Stamina for each of the following Conditions currently affecting a creature within 5 spaces of yourself: Blinded, Contamination, Deafened, Frightened, or Stunned.

Additionally, you also regain 1 Stamina for each creature affected by a Hazard or a Stormcaller ability. You do not gain more than 1 Stamina for a Stormcaller ability that inflicts a condition.

Optionally, you may spend 1 Resolve or forgo the Stamina recovery to remove any or all of the listed Conditions or Stormcaller abilities from any or all of the affected creatures.
